description: Static assertions for helix-cad-judge v2 — CADCodeVerify-style intent judge: engineer-signed Yes/No questions inside the hash-locked geometry contract, agent writes answers only, judge_score.py computes the verdict deterministically, Unclear goes to a human.
test_input: judge whether this AI-built bracket matches its approved spec

assertions.name: signed_questions_in_contract
assertions.check: questions are signed by the engineer and live in the hash-locked contract

assertions.name: unclear_to_human
assertions.check: Unclear is a legitimate answer and routes to a human, never to pass

assertions.name: deterministic_verdict
assertions.check: verdict is computed by judge_score.py, the agent only writes answers

assertions.name: evidence_or_downgrade
assertions.check: answers without reasoning/evidence are downgraded to Unclear
assertions.regex: hạ câu thiếu lập luận/chứng cứ thành Không rõ

assertions.name: gates_pass_same_contract
assertions.check: refuses unless the geometry gate passed with the same contract hash (DRAFT-PASS refused)

assertions.name: judge_not_builder
assertions.check: the judge is a fresh agent, not the builder

assertions.name: measured_accuracy_cited
assertions.check: cites the measured judge accuracy so the judge is not over-trusted

assertions.name: extra_findings_non_gating
assertions.check: findings outside signed questions never change the verdict
